messages:
alex.j: heads-up — CI started failing on DAST evidence upload right after the keystore RBAC change rolled last night. build-1423 shows a 403 from artifact-uploader.

maya.s: ugh. saw the deploy. can you paste the error? is it KMS decrypt or S3 putObject 403?

alex.j: paste from CI log: ```Uploading evidence bundle... POST https://uploader.internal/api/v1/artifacts 403 
{"error":"access denied","actor":"service-account/ci-uploader","reason":"permission denied for keystore/GetKey"}```

ow: scan-bot posted: `DAST evidence bundle failed to upload (build-1423). Error 403` :rotating_light:

ow: owen: likely the ephemeral grant we added for the ci service account didn't propagate to the keystore role binding. RBAC change last night replaced group dev-ci-uploader with dev-ci-pipeline and I guess the binding missed the service account alias.

maya.s: ok quick mitigation — can we flip CI to use artifact-proxy (internal proxy that uses a different keystore key) while we fix the RBAC binding? that proxy uses key arn:arn:keystore:proxy-key and has separate IAM trust.

ow: tara: oncall-rotation, can you bless a short-lived config change? we want a config flag: UPLOAD_PROXY=true for the pipeline. will need an audit entry.

oncall-rotation: I can approve a 2-hour rollback to proxy. Please add a changelog note and include the ticket id. I'm enabling the change window now. :white_check_mark:

alex.j: patch ready: ```env: UPLOAD_PROXY=true
steps: - name: upload
  run: ./ci/upload --use-proxy``` will push in 5. Also creating a tactical PR to add more robust error logging.

maya.s: long term: we need a checklist so future RBAC keystore rotations update all service-account aliases and CI roles. proposal: 1) rotation runbook step to run `keystorectl whohas --service ci-uploader` 2) automated smoke: small upload test post-rotation 3) alert if upload returns 403 for 10m.

ow: owen: agreed. also add audit logging for `keystore:GetKey` with principal and request-id so we can trace which binding failed. Right now logs only show service name and truncated principal.

alex.j: for the current incident I'm adding a debug grep to the uploader logs: `grep GetKey /var/log/uploader/*.log | tail -n 100` — capturing request IDs and timestamp. will attach to the ticket.

scan-bot: auto-detect: build-1423 -> DAST evidence upload failure. Linked ticket SEC-8421 created.

maya.s: once proxy is live, run a controlled DAST run to validate evidence ingestion, then revert RBAC change once corrected. also coordinate with compliance for audit proof of the temporary proxy use — they need the justification note.

tara: I'll add compliance tag and note to SEC-8421. We should include the time window, approved-by, and the exact CI commits.

ow: owen: next steps owner list: alex.j — deploy proxy flag + logs, maya.s — patch runbook + smoke test, tara — compliance note + audit entry, me (owen) — fix RBAC binding and validate keystore policy. target ETA 3h to full fix, proxy will be in 10m.

alex.j: deploying proxy flag now. pushing logs to SEC-8421. will post results in 10.

(now 10m later) alex.j: proxy upload succeeded; DAST job completed and evidence landed in /evidence/2026-03-21/build-1423. no obvious data corruption. closing the urgent channel.

maya.s: follow-up: create a small GH action that runs post-keystore-rotation: `curl -fsS uploader.internal/health && ./ci/upload --test` and fail rotation if upload fails. We should also add a gating check on the rotation PR.

tara: thanks everyone. adding retro note to the security ops board so rotation owners iterate on the runbook. :memo:
